name: Text-to-Image-to-3D Reconstruction
definition: A two-step procedure to reconstruct a 3D object from a text prompt by first generating an image using a 2D diffusion model, then reconstructing that image using RealFusion.
summary: Text-to-Image-to-3D Reconstruction generates 3D models from text by first creating a 2D image with a diffusion model, then reconstructing it via RealFusion, decoupling semantic generation from geometry for easier user control.
